body: Part of e553ce, after dc27f7. skywave-proto: the commands and events from the design, capture events carry a BlobRef. One PROTOCOL_VERSION bump for the batch, a no-op step in PROTOCOL_STEPS in both skywaved/src/db.rs and skywave-core/src/store.rs (tested on data the previous version wrote), and UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 for the wire snapshots.
title: screen 2: wire types for screen commands and capture events
